blind.B1: Yes. Abstract: 21 adolescents (12 M, 9 F) did an acute cycling bout before and after 8-wk endurance training; blood drawn before and right after each bout; monocyte RNA-seq. Exercise factor is within-subject: every sequenced sample (T1-T4, 83) carries it (acute bout and/or training). Time coding 1-4 is not defined in the abstract; the natural reading is pre/post bout before training, pre/post bout after training.
blind.B2: Acute exercise response (post vs pre bout) per sex, pre-training: F 5,135 vs M 567 transcripts; post-training: M 165, F 94. Expected n: 9 F and 12 M subjects per time point (21 per time point; 20 at T4 if one draw is missing). Locator: abstract only; no full text.
blind.B3: Yes. Each adolescent is sampled four times (pre/post bout x pre/post training). Pairing key: the subject prefix AC## of the title (packet A: 'subject' key, 21 keys, links 83/83, no duplicates in any level).
blind.B4: The abstract does not say whether one model was fitted on all time points or each pair alone. Not stated.
blind.B5: 'false discovery rate (FDR) < 0.1' (abstract); no fold-change cutoff stated. Counts: 5,135 F and 567 M pre-training; 165 M and 94 F post-training.

checks.evidence: Abstract: acute exercise + 8-wk training in 21 adolescents; the series was analyzed.

Per-sex n 9 F / 12 M matches the abstract (T4 F has 8: AC06 lacks T4, recorded). Time coding T1-T4 as pre/post bout x pre/post training is an inference, flagged in HANDBACK and supported by T3 vs T1 ~0 DEGs.
design contrasts: control T1/T3, treatment T2/T4 (post bout vs pre bout); T3 vs T1 secondary.
Formula ~ subject + time (fixed subject effect), full rank 24 columns, residual df 59; subject taken from title regex AC##, treated as categorical.

Paper is silent (B4) and the counts differ a lot for males: pre-training 217 vs 567 (paper), post-training 601 vs 165; male T2vsT1 p-values pile near 1 (frac p>0.9 = 0.339). Only the joint 4-time-point model per sex was fitted; no pairwise fit is reported. Joint models share dispersion/variance across all 4 time points and can behave very differently from per-pair paired fits when response sizes differ by time.
checks.fix: Add a pairwise paired execution per sex and contrast (subset to T1+T2 and to T3+T4 only, formula ~ subject + time) and report both fits next to the joint one with counts at padj<0.1; record the joint-vs-pairwise choice as a declared assumption since the paper does not state it.

checks.evidence: No batch/lane/run is deposited (covariance reasoning); sex is a stratum; age is constant within subject. Timepoint-run aliasing cannot be checked and is noted as absent.

Integer featureCounts counts, DESeq2 fits (route declared deviation). p-value histogram piled near 1 in 3 male/female tables (frac p>0.9 0.28-0.34) suggests low-count filtering or dispersion handling may differ from the paper's pipeline; not diagnosed.
checks.fix: State whether a low-count prefilter was applied (n_tested 17.7k of 60.7k genes suggests so) and check the pairwise fits under model_fit.

checks.evidence: Paper rule FDR<0.1 with no FC is transcribed exactly (padj<0.1, strict). Packet B: male T2vsT1 raw p<0.01 gives 571, equal to the GEO summary's 571 for the same contrast, while padj<0.1 gives 217; this fit is not recorded as a discrepancy.
checks.fix: Record in the discrepancies that the male pre-training count fits raw p<0.01 (571) rather than padj<0.1; do not switch the applied rule.

checks.evidence: Pairs compare the same sex, same contrast and same FDR 0.1; HANDBACK and study caveats state that male attenuation is NOT reproduced (217 -> 601 vs 567 -> 165) and that the method is unknown.
No stop or refusal; 12 comparisons analyzable, 6 run.

human_items: Open policy: joint (~ subject + time per sex) vs pairwise paired fits when the paper is silent; the male counts disagree strongly with the paper under the joint fit.

Open policy: the male pre-training count (571 at raw p<0.01, equal to the GEO summary) suggests the authors' stated FDR may not be what produced their number; which rule to report is a person's decision.
Sex x acute-exercise interaction (315 transcripts) and training x acute interaction were not run (runner limitation).
summary: 该案例的运行决定、分组、方向和配对（按 subject 作为固定效应）都正确，阈值 FDR<0.1 转录无误。问题在于论文未说明模型结构，而男性结果与论文差异很大（训练前 217 对 567，训练后 601 对 165），却只报告了每个性别的联合 4 时间点模型，没有报告成对子集拟合；需补充成对配对拟合并记录选择。男性训练前计数在原始 p<0.01 时恰为 571，与 GEO 摘要一致，建议在差异记录中说明。
